$about.purpose: Hand-authored template for The Wandering Pages. Scripted-survey-by-default: a railroad beat with an `options` array is rendered fully scripted (no AI call). Free text from the player still routes through the AI under CANON LOCK + BEAT GUIDANCE.
beat_modes: Fully scripted — beat has `description` + `options[]`. Description rendered verbatim, options used verbatim. No AI on preset picks.
Scripted scene, AI-tailored options — beat has `description` only. Description verbatim; AI generates 2-4 character-appropriate option labels.
No beat — AI improvises within tone/lore/restrictions.
Set `is_final: true` on a beat to end the journey at that scene.
supported_imports: Legacy survey graph — { surveyMeta, nodes[], edges[] }. Root ports become characters; BFS depth ≥ 2 nodes collapse into railroad beats, and their port labels populate each beat's scripted options automatically.
Wrapped exports — { adventure: {...} } or { config: {...} } are auto-unwrapped.
$about.off_track_resilience: When a player ignores the preset options and writes free text, the AI is told to (a) honor their action, (b) steer back toward the next railroad beat, and (c) only reference named entities that exist in `lore` below. Add a Story Bible entry for any person/place/thing you want the AI to be able to invoke.

title: Vumbua Academy: Mid-Week Cram Session
story_context: The Thursday morning horns have faded, and Friday's final grading culls loom like an executioner's blade. To survive the written exam, candidates at Vumbua Academy must choose how to master the curriculum of the seven core classes, while preparing for the high-octane Reszo Circuit Race and handling personal quests.
tone: Mysterious, academic, high-stakes, magical steampunk/resonance fantasy.
restrictions: Stay PG-13. Never invent named NPCs, factions, or locations that aren't in the Story Bible. If the player asks about something off-canon, have an NPC redirect or plead ignorance rather than fabricating lore.
starting_prompt: You are the Game Master. Lead the player through their preparation for the final exam and the Reszo Race at Vumbua Academy. Keep the focus on their chosen character's objectives and their study choices. Present them with challenging choices that test their traits and resolve. If the current node matches a railroad point (such as node 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7), display its 'description' verbatim as the scene text. Do not modify or customize it for the character. Only customize the choices/options to fit the character's background and brief.

railroad_points.description:
The Thursday night air in Vumbua is thick with the scent of ozone, ink, and impending failure. The high-stakes final exam is on Friday, and the Reszo Circuit Race is tomorrow afternoon (Thursday). You have only one night to make your final preparations before the Loom culls the bottom candidates.

Where do you choose to focus your final hours?

options.label: Learn about the Race: Study the Apex Ring track, the spires, and their temporary boons.
Study the Books: Review Volumetric Cartography, Harmonic Resonance, and Reality Anchoring.
Socialize: Get to know the candidates you are competing against.

railroad_points.description:
You begin your selected activity. Depending on your focus area, you dive into a specific option:
- If you chose the **Race**, you can inspect the deactivated Chime Spire/Soft Forge in the Apex Ring yards, or try to overhear Alistair Rookwood's crawler crew discussing water channel tactics.
- If you chose the **Books**, you can cram Silas Thorne's Reality Anchoring formulas in the West Archive Overflow, or study Harmonic Resonance pulse logic.
- If you chose to **Socialize**, you can try to peek at Finch Gable's study sheet in the common room, or spy on Lyra Castellan to find guard patrol shift gaps near Sterling Hall.

options.label: Apex Ring: Inspect the Chime Spire and Soft Forge mechanics
Apex Ring: Overhear Alistair 'The Rook' Rookwood's crawler crew
West Archive: Cram Silas Thorne's Reality Anchoring formulas
West Archive: Cram Harmonic Resonance pulse logic
Sterling Hall: Spy on Lyra Castellan's sentry patrol schedule
Common Room: Peek at Finch Gable's study slate

railroad_points.description:
You must execute your chosen action under pressure. The Game Master prompts a check (DC 12-14) using a relevant Daggerheart v1.6 trait:
- **Agility or Instinct** to inspect the spires or simulate spatial trajectories.
- **Knowledge or Resonance** to decipher Thorne's reality mist equations or tune crystal harmonics.
- **Finesse or Presence** to spy on Finch Gable's slate or overhear Rookwood's crew.

Prepare your roll. Success will unlock valuable clues, while failure will result in stress and memorizing misleading decoy information.

options.label: Roll Instinct to attempt the check
Roll Knowledge to attempt the check
Roll Finesse to attempt the check
Roll Presence to attempt the check
Roll Strength to attempt the check
Roll Resonance to attempt the check

railroad_points.description:
The result of your efforts is locked in. Depending on your roll:
- **Success**: You gain a true clue (such as Chime Spire Resonance, the water shortcut channels, Silas Thorne's Internal Density formula, Sympathetic Tuning logic, Finch's Z-axis paradox, or Lyra's Shift Change Gap) and clear 1 Stress.
- **Failure**: You take 1 Stress and memorize a misleading decoy (confused Soft-Forge notes, decoy water tactics, external bracing fallacy, C-major pulse fallacy, Finch's cheater formulas, or Lyra's fabricated patrol timetable).

options.label: Lock in your insights and prepare for the morning
Rest your brain and sleep

railroad_points.description: Thursday morning arrives. Steam whistles blow, calling all candidates to the Apex Ring. You prepare to face the Reszo Circuit Race and the Loom cull, checking your stress and locking in your acquired clues and insights. This is the conclusion of the study session.

intro_node.description: The Thursday night air is thick with the scent of ozone and impending failure. Choose your identity to begin the mid-week study session and catch up on the events leading to the final exam and Reszo Race:

options.label: Britt Galaspora
options.recap:
**Home & Philosophy:** You are a turtle-mushroom sentinel from the Mycelium clan. Your people live by a strict, ancient code: **"When things stop dying, we start dying."** Lately, the forest has failed to decay properly, signaling a deep structural threat to your homeland.

**What You Have Learned:**
Harmony has been trading solvents and tools to your elders to prune and destroy the forest in exchange for soil, roots, and stone. Neither side fully understands what the other truly wants.
The outside world can be violent and unfeeling. You survived a brutal 2 AM alleyway ambush in Vumbua by a failed candidate named Azor and his bruisers, Zyykl and Tus.
You managed to retain your cherished family heirloom—your petrified acorn necklace—but the thugs made off with your official entrance exam receipt.
While exploring the outer basalt cliffs, you discovered an ancient, abandoned Harmony research cache containing a pristine **Surveyor's Compass** inscribed with: **"momentum is life always towards home."**
You caught Finch Gable red-handed in a side alley attempting to trade secrets to an Indigo Turban enforcer to gain illegal hangar access and spy on second-year builds.

**Open Quests & Loose Ends:**
**The Silent Horizon:** Investigate what corporate secrets Harmony is hiding beneath the basalt layers of the city.
**The Lost Receipt:** Track down Zyykl and Tus to recover your pride.
**The VIP Passage:** Meet Valentine Sterling at the Colonnade to board his family's high-society airship, the *Zephyr*, before the race.
options.brief: A sentinel from the Mycelium Clan investigating the forest stagnation. Suspicious of Harmony. Carries the Surveyor's Compass. Seeks her stolen receipt from Azor, Zyykl, and Tus. Knows Finch Gable is trading secrets with the Indigo Turbans. Has tickets to board Valentine Sterling's airship Zephyr.

options.label: Aggie Galaspora
options.recap:
**Home & Philosophy:** You are a red-and-white spotted mushroom-turtle. Unlike your outspoken cousin Britt, you are a quieter scholar, but you share her deep, unspoken mission: to uncover the truth and save your people from the unnatural stagnation of Vumbua.

**What You Have Learned:**
When new civilizations are integrated into Harmony, corporate policy traditionally grants them immense political power (such as Lady Ignis holding high voting seats) to ensure cooperative alignment.
Harmony technology is entirely powered by "resonance," a raw energy flowing through the world that must be carefully dampened and controlled using valuable Umber Crystals to prevent cataclysmic explosions.
Professor Thorne's lecture revealed the existence of **Dead Islands**—hollow vacuums where energy vanishes, and nothing ever returns to the cyclical flow of life and death, which you suspect is the inverse parallel to your un-dying home forest.
Valentine Sterling is a brilliant but isolated young student. He is constantly surrounded and gatekept by his Castellan twin handlers, Lyra and Ludo.

**Open Quests & Loose Ends:**
**The Comms Test:** Activate and monitor the prototype "Speaking Stone" Kael lent you to establish a secure party network.
**The Elite Study Group:** Use your friendly connection with Val to secure a private, high-tier tutoring session on the VIP deck before the final exam.
**The Study Circle:** Maintain your academic alliance with Pip, Bramble, and Saffron to keep a pulse on the student body.
options.brief: A quieter scholar of the Mizizi Clan. Investigating the Dead Islands and forest stagnation. Currently testing Kael's prototype Speaking Stone. Member of the student study circle with Pip, Bramble, and Saffron. Seeking tutoring on the Zephyr VIP deck with Valentine Sterling, despite Lyra and Ludo's presence.

options.label: ignatious Magmatoa
options.recap:
**Home & Philosophy:** You are a rebellious, proud Ash-Blood teenager. Your elders viewed your departure to Vumbua as a banishment trial; you proudly reframed it as a sacred pilgrimage to find the source of your clan's fading heat.

**What You Have Learned:**
Harmony's synthetic "safe-flame" crystal batteries feel fake and unnatural. You believe the city is swapping out genuine spiritual heat for artificial energy.
Team 1's heavy crawler, **The Ironclad** (Shatter Stamper), is a treaded brick built for strategic bottlenecks and attrition rather than flashy acrobatics. It is backed by Lady Ignis and the progressive Ash Reds faction.
You infiltrated Hangar Bay 12 on Iggy's shoulders and got caught by Warden Rovaldi's mechanical eye. You managed to slip away while Iggy caused a distraction.
You successfully pre-warmed the engine manifolds of the *Ironclad* using your raw Ash-Blood fire, earning the respect of Alistair "The Rook" Rookwood.

**Open Quests & Loose Ends:**
**Ember's Marker:** Cash in the future favor you negotiated with your cousin Ember after saving their crawler block.
**The Commander's Desk:** Survive Friday's 20,000-student academic cull.
options.brief: An Ash-Blood fire-keeper seeking the Volcano's Heart to stop the Great Cooling. Works on the crawler The Ironclad with Alistair Rookwood and the Ash Reds. Evading Warden Rovaldi. Holds favors from Ember and Valerius.

options.label: Loami Siltano
options.recap:
**Home & Philosophy:** You are a working-class, blue-collar grease monkey born and raised in the geothermal depths of the boiler rooms. Your family taught you the ultimate rule of survival: **"Someone's got to fix the ship if it goes wrong."**

**What You Have Learned:**
You are a massive fan of the high-octane Reszo Circuit Race. You know the tracks are 50/50 land and water, and the spires roll into randomized positions out of underground bunkers.
You formed a strong alliance with Sarge and the campus smugglers. You negotiated an official bootlegging partnership with Lucky to sell your potent, furnace-grade "Ambrosia of Luck" grog to the roaring crowds.
Finch Gable is an arrogant academic rival who refused to share notes and insulted you in ballistics class.
You established order during Azor's alleyway interrogation by delivering a crushing punch that shattered his rib, proving you are not to be trifled with.

**Open Quests & Loose Ends:**
**Grog or Glory:** Choose whether to stay on the ground to run the "Ambrosia of Luck" racket with Lucky or abandon the scheme to sit with the elite on Val's luxury airship.
**The Crew Covenant:** Ace the final exam to officially cement your right to join an exploration crew.
options.brief: A blue-collar mechanic from the boiler rooms. Smuggling partner of Sarge and Lucky, distributing the Ambrosia of Luck. Rivals with Finch Gable. Must choose between the grog racket with Lucky or the Zephyr VIP deck with Valentine Sterling. Wants to form an official exploration crew.

options.label: Iggy Ashvein
options.recap:
**Home & Philosophy:** You are a curious, light-sensitive Underborn Trench-Kin who emerged from the watery docks of Vumbua. You mask your identity from the proctors while methodically cataloging the surface world in your journal.

**What You Have Learned:**
Surface foods like muffins and bacon are incredible, though open skies and wind are deeply disorienting.
Professor Kante unraveled a terrifying system secret: the world's **Global Amplitude is in an unprecedented 40-year decline**. The Ash-Blood integration yielded an anomaly—producing almost no energy boost.
Panda 5 resonator batteries are over-engineered surge capacitors/receptors, not true energy storage blocks.
Professor Kante is a kindred academic soul who gifted you a raw **Umber Crystal** and validated your clockwork engineering talents.
Warden Rovaldi possesses a highly advanced mechanical eye that scans different energy spectrums.

**Open Quests & Loose Ends:**
**The Connection Paradox:** Reconcile Kante's belief that "connection saves worlds" with your clan's warning that outside contact breeds apocalypse.
**The Anomalous Shadow:** Evade Lucky, who is actively hunting down "stories" like you.
options.brief: An Underborn Trench-Kin researcher. Mentored by Professor Kante at the Walker-Core power plant. Studying the Global Amplitude decline and Panda 5 resonator batteries. Evading Warden Rovaldi and Lucky. Associated with Zephyr.

lore.name: Mycelium Clan
lore.body: Also known as the Mizizi clan, a society of turtle-mushroom sentinels who live by the cyclical code: 'When things stop dying, we start dying.'

lore.name: Harmony
lore.body: The dominant corporate empire of the region, utilizing resonance technology to power and control integrated societies.

lore.name: Azor
lore.body: A failed academy candidate who now runs a small gang of bruisers, including Zyykl and Tus, extorting candidates in the back alleys of Vumbua.

lore.name: Zyykl and Tus
lore.body: Thugs under Azor who ambushed Britt and stole her official entrance exam receipt.

lore.name: Surveyor's Compass
lore.body: An ancient, pristine compass found in an abandoned Harmony research cache, inscribed with: 'momentum is life always towards home.'

lore.name: Finch Gable
lore.body: An arrogant elite candidate who is secretly trading academy secrets to enforcers for hangar access.

lore.name: Indigo Turbans
lore.body: A powerful local faction or enforcer group in Vumbua who controls access to the docks and hangars.

lore.name: Valentine Sterling
lore.body: A brilliant but isolated high-society student who drafted a helpful study guide. He is closely monitored by his Castellan handlers.

lore.name: Zephyr
lore.body: The luxurious Sterling family airship docked at the Colonnade, offering a VIP view of the Reszo Circuit Race.

lore.name: Lucky
lore.body: A prominent info broker and smuggler on campus who runs underground operations and actively hunts down anomalous entities.

lore.name: Lady Ignis
lore.body: A former military general from the Ashlin Islands holding a high voting seat in Harmony corporate politics.

lore.name: Umber Crystals
lore.body: Valuable, highly reactive minerals used to dampen and control resonance energy to prevent catastrophic explosions.

lore.name: Professor Thorne
lore.body: Silas Thorne, the grim Academy archivist and professor of Reality Anchoring, who supervises the West Archive Overflow.

lore.name: Dead Islands
lore.body: Mysterious, hollow vacuums in the sky where resonance energy reaches zero and nothing returns to the lifecycle.

lore.name: Lyra and Ludo
lore.body: The aggressive Castellan twin handlers assigned to monitor and control Valentine Sterling.

lore.name: Speaking Stone
lore.body: A prototype communication device lent by Kael to establish a secure party study network.

lore.name: Pip, Bramble, and Saffron
lore.body: A circle of first-year candidates who collaborate with Aggie to monitor student body gossip and study patterns.

lore.name: The Ironclad
lore.body: Team 1's heavy Shatter Stamper crawler, built for attritional defense and supported by the Ash Reds.

lore.name: Ash Reds
lore.body: A progressive political faction of the Ash Blood clan advocating for mechanical modernization and integration.

lore.name: Warden Rovaldi
lore.body: A security warden at Vumbua Academy with a mechanical eye capable of scanning aetheric energy spectrums.

lore.name: Alistair "The Rook" Rookwood
lore.body: The seasoned captain of the Ironclad crawler crew who values raw fire-keeping talent.

lore.name: Volcano's Heart
lore.body: An untamed, authentic volcanic node that the Ash-Blood elders claim holds the cure to the Great Cooling of their islands.

lore.name: Ember
lore.body: ignatious's cousin who works on crawler block construction and owes ignatious a blank favor.

lore.name: Valerius
lore.body: A student gambler from whom ignatious and Loami won a blank favor in a game of Crown and Ruin.

lore.name: Reszo Circuit Race
lore.body: An annual mock-exploration race where teams navigate a changing land-and-water track to light a central node.

lore.name: Sarge
lore.body: A campus smuggler and bootlegger allied with Loami in the deep boiler rooms.

lore.name: Ambrosia of Luck
lore.body: Loami's furnace-grade bootleg grog, produced for distribution at the Reszo Race.

lore.name: Professor Kante
lore.body: A clockwork engineering professor at the Walker-Core power plant who believes connection can stabilize the world's energy.

lore.name: Global Amplitude decline
lore.body: An unprecedented 40-year decline in ambient global energy resonance, which has caused alarm among top researchers.

lore.name: Panda 5 resonator batteries
lore.body: Over-engineered surge capacitors capable of absorbing massive resonance spikes but unable to store true energy.

lore.name: Walker-Core power plant
lore.body: A heavy industrial power plant in Vumbua where Professor Kante tests experimental resonance batteries.

lore.name: Kael
lore.body: A student technician at Vumbua Academy who designs and lends custom communications equipment like Speaking Stones.

lore.name: Zaza
lore.body: A wise herbalist and healer in Vumbua who knows how to treat shell decay and ancient security mechanisms.

lore.name: Vumbua
lore.body: The towering, vertical city-academy built around the central Loom, powered by Harmony resonance.

lore.name: West Archive Overflow
lore.body: The restricted, towering library stacks of Vumbua Academy overseen by Professor Silas Thorne.

lore.name: Apex Ring
lore.body: The massive outdoor training yards and race track of Vumbua Academy where crawler rigs are tested.

lore.name: Sterling Hall
lore.body: The residential hall and VIP facilities for elite students at Vumbua Academy, guarded by the Castellan twins.

lore.name: Hangar Bay 12
lore.body: A restricted construction hangar in the Vumbua docks where crawler rigs like the Ironclad are assembled.

lore.name: Mizizi Forest Stagnation
lore.body: A crisis in the Mycelium home forest where the natural cycle of death and decay has halted.

lore.name: Great Cooling
lore.body: The environmental collapse of the Ashlin Islands, where the natural volcanic heat is fading.

lore.name: Finch's secret trading
lore.body: Finch Gable has been trading confidential academy schematics to enforcers in exchange for restricted hangar access.

lore.name: Rovaldi's scanning
lore.body: Warden Rovaldi's mechanical eye is tuned to detect individuals lacking Harmony's synthetic energy resonance.

lore.name: Lost Receipt theft
lore.body: Azor's gang holds Britt's stolen receipt, planning to extort her or use it for illegal entry.
